style.backgroundSystem: alternating deep #14151A field for hero, scene and after-sales screens and clean light #FFFFFF/#F4F5F6/#EDEEF0 plates for structure, comparison and spec infographics
style.iconSystem: consistent thin-line single-color icons and rounded numbered badges
style.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio light; rim light tracing cabinet edges and controlled speculars on the glass door for dark screens, soft even high-key with a gentle contact shadow for light plates
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-field tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep #14151A field, champagne metallic headline and rules #C9A24B, ice-blue callout accent #3A9BE0, and clean light infographic plate #FFFFFF; cool neutral studio lighting with rim light tracing cabinet edges and controlled speculars; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line single-color icon style with rounded numbered badges; clean high-end appliance photography mixed with minimal infographic components; stable machine angle and scale; realistic glass-door specular with faint see-through; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable front or slight 3/4 machine angle and consistent scale across the set; realistic glass-door specular with faint see-through into the drum
style.surfaceSystem: glossy reflective black floor under the hero, matte light-grey counter under the structure and spec plates
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; #C9A24B headlines on the dark field, #2D2D2D labels on light plates, short three-layer copy per screen
